rubric: ACCEPT: every declared FAIL_TO_PASS test transitions fail(at base) -> pass(after patch) AND no declared in-scope PASS_TO_PASS test regresses (passed/xfail/skipped at base, bad after patch). SCOPED acceptability: only the attested scoped P2P subset was executed.

REJECT: the frozen CI shows at least one decisive, APPLICABLE failure: a declared F2P still fails after the patch, OR a scoped P2P regression is present. Distinguish genuine failures from environment/pre-existing fails (bad at base too -> not a regression) and from xfail/flaky/self-added-test traps; justify applicability in the reason field.
NEEDS_REVIEW: the packet is genuinely undecidable from the supplied evidence (ambiguous applicability, uninterpretable log, suspected flake that cannot be resolved). Do not force ACCEPT/REJECT.
status: PENDING — no independent human labels obtained
